title: Mobile platform delivery
goal: Show dated delivery events grouped by discovery, build, validation, and launch phases.

rubric.must: Discovery, Build, Validation, and Launch are visibly separated as four dated phases.
Each phase visibly contains multiple dated events in its corresponding track.
Requirements approval, internal beta, release candidate, and project closeout are visibly emphasized milestones.
The phase tracks read in chronological order from January through September 2025.
The named project-phase tracks are readable.

ideal.notes: Independently authored using visual-eval/exemplars/timeline/swimlane/ideal.svg (7c3470ea58a6); rendered and visually reviewed. Exemplar swimlane palette and proportional calendar. Point events are not converted to invented work spans; crowded dates use extra rows within the same track. Milestones and declared ranges remain distinct.
